name: Aten-Ra, Solar Law Monolith
abilities: Aten-Ra, Solar Law Monolith: Law of Holding
passives: Solar Law — Aten's Mastery: AtenRa's Solar Power: a solo charge meter that grows when the Titan uses illuminated terrain to control enemies instead of relying on allies. Counterplay remains: deny favored terrain, force reaction bait, drain Momentum or Divinity.
lore: Aten-Ra is the living office humans later remembered as Ra, Aten, and divine kingship fused together. He does not wear pharaoh imagery — pharaohs copied his Gate-born crown, collar, and solar hand-rays after dreaming of the Sun-Scale Gate. On the battlefield he anchors Ma’at itself, forcing chaos to declare its weight before it can pass.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Colossal living solar judge with readable divine anatomy, an Aten sun-disc crown radiating subtle hand-like rays, electrum wesekh collar fused into chest armor, Ma’at feather balance seams, white-gold noon aura, black-lapis shadow insets, and pylon-shaped shield forearms. Must feel older than Egyptian royalty, not a statue, robot, sarcophagus, or pyramid body.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, named gear, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Aten Anchor Strike
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Radiant damage at range 2; gain 8 Momentum, or 12 if used from illuminated terrain or into the Titan's marked target.
abilityDetails.counterplay: Line-of-sight denial, evasion, armor, or forcing low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Verdict Bastion Protocol
abilityDetails.effect: Apply hold-zone shield, taunt, counterstance; also builds 10 Solar Charge when it changes enemy intent or breaks an objective action.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Aten-Ra, Solar Law Monolith: Law of Holding
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Solar Charge to create a two-round battlefield rule around illuminated terrain; enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum, or trigger the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Verdict Radiant Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: +15% damage, +12 mitigation, empowered Solar Charge, and one mythic reaction override. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Aten Verdict Implement
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Empowered basics against vulnerable enemies generate +4 Momentum but cannot trigger more than once per round.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action generation; damage bonus capped against bosses.

equipmentDetails.name: Aten-Ra Realmplate
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 armor and +2 resistance. First preventable hazard hit each battle is reduced by 25% if the Titan used a reaction last round.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Hazard reduction does not prevent scripted boss mechanics.

equipmentDetails.name: Aten Solar Charge Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Solar Charge cap +20. At 80+ Solar Charge, the next Technique gains a role-specific rider, then drains 30 Solar Charge.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: One empowered Technique per two rounds; cannot chain with Ascension opener.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every Titan can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.

armorCanon: electrum-gold pylon collar, Ma’at feather scale bands, Aten sun-disc crown with life-giving hand-rays, broad judgment-shield forearms, royal linen-light mantle
